newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms seek 22,000T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms seek 22,000T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd would jointly invite tenders to buy a total of 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat at 1:00 p.m. (0400 GMT) on Friday, traders said on Thursday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang would invite tenders for 9,000 tonnes at basis prices over September futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges, including the Chicago Board of Trade, traders said.
Dongah Flour would invite the remaining 13,000 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for July 1-31 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
